system: mixed system of common law, based on Anglo-American law and customary law

constitution.history: previous 1847 (at independence); latest drafted 19 October 1983, revision adopted by referendum 3 July 1984, effective 6 January 1986
constitution.amend: proposed by agreement of at least two thirds of both National Assembly houses or by petition of at least 10,000 citizens; passage requires at least two-thirds majority approval of both houses and approval in a referendum by at least two-thirds majority of registered voters

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of a chief justice and 4 associate justices)
courts.judges: chief justice and associate justices appointed by the president of Liberia with consent of the Senate; judges can serve until age 70
courts.lower: judicial circuit courts; special courts, including criminal, civil, labor, traffic; magistrate and traditional or customary courts
courts.note: the Supreme Court has jurisdiction for all constitutional cases

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Liberia

world: accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction with reservations; accepts ICCt jurisdiction
